div.head: Cn 1018 14.6
div.ab: And sancte eadwardes mæssedæg. witan habbað gecoran þæt man freolsian sceal. ofer eall englaland. on. xv. kalendas. Aprilis.
And sancte Eadwardes mæssedæg witan habbað gecoran þæt man freolsian sceal ofer eall Englaland on XV kalendas Aprilis.
And the councillors have decided that the festival of St Edward shall be celebrated throughout England on 18 March.
And the council has determined that the Feast of Saint Edward shall be celebrated throughout England on the fifteenth day before the kalends of April.
